description: Create a new Shopify page in a Fudge draft, optionally with its own template. It can be previewed in the draft and goes live when the merchant publishes.

createCustomTemplate.description: Create a fresh custom template for this page (default true). False uses the default page template; assign an existing template afterwards with edit_entities on templateSuffix.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: create_draft_page
title: Create page in draft
